items.headline: No Big Ten football teams in AP top 5 for first time since '21
items.description: A weekend of Big Ten upsets left the conference without a team in the top 5 of the AP Top 25 college football poll for the first time since 2021.

items.headline: AP college football Week 12 poll reaction: What's next for Top 25
items.description: A look at the AP rankings, along with a key stat and what's ahead for each team.

items.headline: Which teams have the best odds to make the College Football Playoff?
items.description: We are tracking the odds for making the CFP, earning a bye and winning it all.

items.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
items.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

items.headline: Betting buzz: Big Ten's odds of national champion four-peat getting slim
items.description: Losses by UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State make the Big Ten's chances of winning the national championship this season a long shot.

items.headline: No. 13 Iowa shuts out Illinois in the second half, pulls away for 34-17 win to help playoff hopes
items.description: — L.J. Phillips Jr. ran for 154 yards and a touchdown, Iowa's stingy defense shut out Illinois in the second half, and the No. 13 Hawkeyes beat the Fighting Illini 34-17 on Saturday to give their College Football Playoff hopes a big boost.
